authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3120 kāṣṭha gives kāṭh/kāṭhī wood and fuel. The simple kāth/kathi firewood forms fit; kaṭhua needs a suffix or adjective analysis. Reviewed comparison: DewasDoneDanuwar kaṭʰi “firewood” (f_3y4sakyt5om44). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9883 markaṭa spider gives Nepali mākuro and regional makṛā/makarā. These spider forms fit that family, distinct from the similar monkey head. Reviewed comparison: DewasDoneDanuwar makuri “spider” (f_pmegns4vcvou6). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
